## Categorize Transaction

Single Responsibility: resolve description → categoryId via keyword matching against your real categories (fetched live, never hardcoded IDs). Falls back to a category literally named "Uncategorized" if present, then to the first category of the right type, in that order.

Does not call the BudgetFlow API directly — delegates to 03 - BudgetFlow API Client / Get Categories, which owns auth, retries, and error notification for that call. This workflow only owns the keyword-matching logic.

Edit the keywordMap in 'Match Category by Keyword' to match your own category names/vocabulary.

Input: output of 02 - Processing / Duplicate Check.
Output (category resolved): passthrough + { categoryId, categoryName, categorizeConfidence } → forwarded to 03 - Create Transaction. If categorizeConfidence < 0.5, ALSO (in parallel, non-blocking) notifies 04 - Notifications / Low Confidence Import so you can review it later without stopping the import.
Output (no category could be resolved at all): routes to 04 - Notifications / Import Failed and stops here.
Output (Get Categories failed): Get Categories has already notified System Error; this workflow simply stops.
